name: weekly-summary
description: Every Monday at 9:00, asks Claude to sum up the week in this project, always in the same PPM chat so it can compare with the weeks before, and sends you the answer as a notification that opens the chat.

inputs.label: What to ask
inputs.default: Sum up what changed in this project over the last 7 days: read `git log --since='7 days ago' --stat` and the work in progress. Say what is done, what is still open and what looks risky, in under 15 lines. If you summed up an earlier week in this chat, say what moved since.
